links.outcome: LLM accuracy on ACL guideline questions with versus without RAG grounding
links.effect: All noncustom LLMs started below 60% accuracy; RAG improved every model's accuracy by an average 39.7%; best RAG model Llama3 70b reached 94%.
links.quote: Applying RAG improved the accuracy of every model by an average 39.7%.

unlisted_practices: Adding AI agents on top of RAG-augmented LLMs to improve accuracy (GPT-4 reached 95%)

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) and agent augmentation of existing LLMs
screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the impact of adding retrieval augmented generation (RAG) grounding and AI agents to existing LLMs compared to baseline models without grounding on clinical accuracy for ACL guidelines.

primary.practice: retrieval augmented generation and agentic augmentation
